test_title: PYST 169: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 13 Feb, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight girls P, Q, R, S, U, V, T and W are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. V is sitting to the immediate left of Q and to the immediate right of U. W is sitting third to the left of V and second to the right of P. R is the immediate neighbour of P and Q. T is sitting fourth to the left of R. Who is sitting third to the left of U?
solution: Given: Eight girls P, Q, R, S, U, V, T and W are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. 1) V is sitting to the immediate left of Q and to the immediate right of U. 2) W is sitting third to the left of V and second to the right of P. 3) R is the immediate neighbour of P and Q.
